method.model: Ridge regression on log yield per region x crop: May-August monthly temperature, rain, PET, water balance, hot days (Tmax >= 27 C), irrigation x drought, technology trend; plus a shrunken farm effect.
method.c2: Change of 2041-2060 mean vs 1991-2020 mean; p_bad_year = share of years below 80 % of the 1991-2020 mean (TASKS_AND_SCORING.md C2).
method.c3: EUR risk = shortfall volume x contract price x replacement premium (SCENARIOS_AND_RISK.md).
method.standards: SSP1-2.6 / SSP2-4.5 / SSP5-8.5 climate scenarios (FMI CMIP6 signals in the package).
